title: TV Advertising 101: Pros & Cons of Television Marketing
summary: Explore how TV advertising campaigns drive results, from traditional and CTV to targeting, measurement, and creative best practices.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Key Takeaways


What marketers need to know about the shift from linear TV to performance-focused CTV.


1. 1


Streaming leads TV viewing, pushing advertisers beyond broadcast and cable.


2. 2


CTV pairs premium impact with digital targeting, measurement, and optimization.


3. 3


Linear TV delivers scale, but less precision, flexibility, and ROI visibility.


4. 4


Campaigns need clear goals, strong creative, disciplined budgets, and optimization.


5. 5


CTV makes television a full-funnel channel with measurable outcomes.
